name: WDUi Framework SDK
changes_cs: Aktualizovany WDUi Framework SDK: proprietarni binarni x64 SDK s hlavickami, wdui.lib, default skiny/fonty, binarnim demem a otevrenou ukazkou pouziti bez zdrojovych cpp souboru knihovny. Tato verze zrychluje Direct2D image cestu: skiny, ikony, tintovane bitmap controls a nine-slice bitmapy se skladaji pres target-specific nativni ID2D1Bitmap cache misto GDI AlphaBlend fallbacku a diagnostika hlasi image bitmap paint/create pocty.
changes_en: Updated WDUi Framework SDK: proprietary binary x64 SDK with headers, wdui.lib, default skins/fonts, binary demo, and an open usage example without library cpp sources. This version speeds up the Direct2D image path: skins, icons, tinted bitmap controls, and nine-slice bitmaps are composited through a target-specific native ID2D1Bitmap cache instead of the GDI AlphaBlend fallback, with image bitmap paint/create diagnostics.
